title: Golden Demon Sorceress
description: A female sorceress in ornate black and gold demonic armor stands in a dynamic pose on a stone floor. She wears a horned golden mask, a flowing red and gold cape, and wields purple magical energy from her hands while golden light rays shine down from above.
prompt: A powerful female sorceress stands in a dramatic combat pose on cracked stone tiles, wearing intricate black and gold demonic armor with spiked pauldrons and clawed gauntlets. She has a fierce horned golden mask covering her face, long flowing dark hair with red accents, and a tattered red cape with golden edges billowing behind her. Purple arcane smoke swirls around her legs as she channels magic from her raised hand. Dramatic golden god rays cut through a dark background, creating high contrast and cinematic lighting.
